summary: Frontend-only retest of the /trep refinements from iteration 9. All 4 requested checks pass. (1) The acta detail panel clears and shows the empty instruction whenever a filter changes: switching to Sucre>Ciencia y tecnología, switching to Monteagudo, typing structure number '10', and typing direct '10' after opening Ánfora 1 all reset it, and the list shows 'No existen actas consolidadas con estos filtros.' (2) Exact search: direct '1' and ' 1 ' (trimmed) match Ánfora 1. Direct '10', '11', '01' and '2' do not match. Structure '1' matches and structure '10', '01', '11' do not. (3) At 1920, 1440 and 1280 px, all 5 controls (2 levels, recinto, mesa, number) sit in one row at y=373 with equal 224px widths. (4) The DB snapshot hashes are unchanged before and after.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: if a filter changes while the GET for an acta is still in flight, setActa(data) runs after the clearing effect and shows an acta that no longer matches the filters. Fix with a request id or AbortController, or by checking that the acta is still in the filtered list.

issues: The placeholder 'Número de ánfora en esta estructura' is cut off ('...en esta') at a 224px width. Use a shorter placeholder such as 'N° ánfora' or add a label.
Between 768 and 1279 px (md:grid-cols-2), 5 controls make 3 rows and the number input sits alone on the last row. Consider lg:grid-cols-3 or making the input span 2 columns.

Data only: recinto 'Fac. Ciencia y Tecnología' is under the node 'FACULTAD: Derecho'. Level labels are inconsistent (FACULTAD vs Facultad) and a level-0 node has a trailing space ('Monteagudo '). Ciudad and Sede nodes are mixed in one root select.

action_items: Optional: guard abrirActa against stale responses
Optional: shorten the structure number placeholder and fix the md/lg grid wrap
critical_code_review_comments: TrepPublicoPage.jsx: the clearing effect at lines 38-40 is correct. rutaNodos always gets a new array identity from seleccionarNodo, so the effect fires reliably.
abrirActa has no try/catch or loading state. A failed GET produces an unhandled promise rejection and gives the user no feedback.
